_note: Model tiers for the local side-work agent (opencode on Ollama) on a 16 GB card (Radeon RX 9060 XT). An agent needs a model with reliable TOOL CALLING and a long context, so these are the Qwen3 family, not qwen2.5-coder (reported to hang in opencode's tool loop). Tags and sizes come from third-party summaries of the Ollama library: confirm with `ollama pull`. approx_gb is the Q4_K_M download; weights plus kv_cache_overhead_gb must fit vram_gb to stay fully on the GPU. `sidework.py prepare` bakes `context` into a derived model because Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores per-request context.

fast.note: quick and light; weakest at long tool loops. Good for docs and small data files

main.note: the default: tool-capable 14B with a thinking mode. Fits with a 32K context on 16 GB

stretch.note: MoE coder built for agentic use, but it does not fit in 16 GB so part runs on the CPU. Measure its speed before relying on it
